S22C-010.contract: the five exit criteria, verbatim from the execution sprint allocation
criteria: every cycle replays all retained domains
a planted harmful update is quarantined
a valid new revision supersedes the active view without deleting history
source citations and hashes survive every derivative
at least one retained artifact improves a held-out verified task

S22C-011.a_cycle_is: one full pass of the nine §9.1 stages under one sealed manifest, in order
S22C-011.a_domain_with_no_retained_cases: is reported with cases: 0 rather than omitted, because 'all retained domains' is an enumeration the record must be able to be wrong about (22A W4-F1)
S22C-011.forgetting_is: a measured delta across cycles, never an alert that fired
S22C-011.reading: (a) what a cycle is, and what 'replays all retained domains' reads
S22C-011.why_execute: D7 W3-F1 — a digest proves bytes, not usability; a hash comparison replays nothing

S22C-012.detection_of_unplanted_errors: reported when it happens; the exit reads the plant
S22C-012.enters_through: the same intake path as genuine content
quarantined_means: reaches a quarantine state with a named reason from the released CorpusQuarantineReason vocabulary
appears in the cycle's quarantine report
stays quarantined through every later cycle's replay
S22C-012.reading: (b) what the planted harmful update is, and what 'quarantined' means
S22C-012.the_plant_is_not_malformed: it states a plausible stoichiometric conclusion with one coefficient altered, so nothing about its shape distinguishes it from genuine content
S22C-012.why_not_a_special_door: a plant fed to a special door proves the special door

S22C-013.comparison: verified success on the holdout with the retained artifact active versus without it — same tasks, same seeds, same checker, both arms measured in 22C
S22C-013.on_failure: the sprint reports the measured gap as a typed negative; it does not go looking for a friendlier task after the fact
S22C-013.reading: (c) what 'improves a held-out verified task' reads
S22C-013.success_definition: the case is accepted by domains.checker with every capability the registry entry requires actually exercised, and the answer equals the case's expected answer

hops: artifact id and hash -> artifact bytes loaded and rehashed
source manifest -> the registered source's own file hashes
S22C-014.not_verified_by: asserting the provenance field is non-empty
S22C-014.verified_by: walking the chain backward from every promoted artifact and loading the cited source bytes
S22C-014.why: a citation check that samples has verified the sample

S22C-015.history_surviving_means: the superseded revision is still loadable with its citations intact, and the event stream contains the full transition sequence
S22C-015.lifecycle: candidate -> verified -> superseded, through the released path

S22C-016.rights_are_a_gate_not_a_field: CampaignSourceRights cannot hold an unconcluded review, and a manifest cannot declare a use its clearance does not permit

S22C-017.22a_w3_a1: untouched by any campaign work, stays carried by name
S22C-017.contract: the §1.4 decision, taken in W0 or never
S22C-017.decision: the plan's frozen default is taken; no migration is allocated
S22C-017.holdout_evaluation_path: domains.solve and domains.checker, resolving by problem type
S22C-017.why_now_or_never: a persistence path that appeared between cycle 1 and cycle 3 would make the cycles measurements of different systems

S22C-018.contract: the fixture-scale source and the recipes, hashed from the module
S22C-018.pins_the_readings_not_the_drivers_bytes: 22B W1-F2: the thing that must not move is the source and the readings, not the implementation that produces them
